## Problem

Describe the user problem, not only the proposed implementation.

## Proposed Outcome

Describe the behavior users should have after this work is complete.

## User And Context

Who needs this, and in which situation?

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Criterion is observable and testable.

## Scope

List what is included and explicitly excluded.

## Technical Notes

Add relevant API, data, security, migration, or compatibility considerations.

## References

Link related PRD requirements, decisions, designs, or issues.
